title: No Sharpness particle
description: Removes the enchanted hit particles when you hit an entity with a sharpness sword.
body:
# 💥 No Sharpness Particle

Get a clearer view during combat by removing the **blue Sharpness particles** that appear when hitting entities with a Sharpness-enchanted weapon.

## ✨ Features

* 🔹 Removes the **blue Sharpness hit particles**.
* 👀 Reduces visual clutter during intense PvP fights.
* ⚔️ Used by many competitive PvP players for better visibility.
* 🚀 May provide a small FPS improvement by reducing particle effects.
* 🎨 Simple, lightweight, and vanilla-friendly.

> Keep your focus on the fight—not the particles.
